scientific_integrity: The proof is analytic for all n>=3 and tau>0; finite exact and high-precision computations independently stress-test specified instances, not replace proof. No authorship, independent validation, or complete novelty certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Only unweighted undirected cycles, exactly two equally weighted vertex sensors, consecutive observations at times zero through floor(n/2), and determinant of the full untreated observability Gramian. The analytic result is not a claim about noise robustness, smallest eigenvalues, other sensing horizons, or nonpositive/degenerate spectral functions. General theory and neighboring classifications pre-exist; specialized prior coverage remains a risk.
title: Exact two-sensor D-optimality and a parity gap in cyclic heat observability
